in_sanskrit.name: Shakandas
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shakandas is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shak' meaning power and 'Andas' meaning man or ruler. This name signifies one who has the power to rule over the earth.

in_hindi.name: शिकन्दर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Shikander in Hindi translates to 'Ruler of the Earth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shak' meaning power and 'Andar' meaning one who is in or rules over. This name signifies one who has the power to rule over the earth.

in_tamil.name: சிகந்தர
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Sikander in Tamil translates to 'The Wise Ruler'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shak' meaning power and 'Andar' meaning one who is in or rules over. This name signifies one who has the wisdom and power to rule.

in_telugu.name: శిగందర
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Sikander in Telugu translates to 'Lord of the Earth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shak' meaning power and 'Andar' meaning one who is in or rules over. This name signifies one who has the power and authority to rule over the earth.

in_marathi.name: Sikander
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sikander हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name of god Shiva and also a name of great Persian and Hindu king, meaning one who conquers or subdues.
